$comment: Hand-maintained facts about the AGWP v1 HTTP API that docs/protocol/openapi.json does not carry. Both SDK generators (sdk/typescript/scripts/generate.mjs and sdk/python/scripts/generate.py) read this file; their tests fail when it disagrees with the OpenAPI document. 'retry' classes: read = GET, or a POST that only reads; natural = repeating the call has the same effect as making it once; keyed = the server records the outcome under the Idempotency-Key header (verified for exactly these four operations against ag-server 0.1.0); unsafe = a repeat may apply twice, so the SDK never retries it on its own (pass an explicit override per call).

alwaysPresent.$comment: Message-typed fields that the protocol declares optional (so the OpenAPI document says '| null') but that ag-server 0.1.0 always fills in. The SDKs type them as present; a live test per field fails if the server ever answers null.

bodies.$comment: Operations whose HTTP body or response is not JSON. The OpenAPI document only says 'binary or event-stream body'.
